title_zh: 限定课堂调查的相关性表述

scenario.label_zh: 限定课堂调查的相关性表述
scenario.goal_zh: 核对两组记录是否可比，并约定重新计算后只描述相关而不宣称因果

context_zh: 虚构数据课：学生检查自己对睡眠时长与记忆测验成绩的分析。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: These scores seem to correlate with the hours of sleep people reported. Can I say sleep improved memory?

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Not from this class survey alone. Were the two groups given comparable tests?

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Actually, one group had twenty pictures and the other had thirty. I used the raw number remembered.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Then compute the proportion remembered before comparing them. Even that won't remove every difference between the tests.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Right. If the pattern remains, I'll describe a correlation in our sample, not a cause.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: And include the different test lengths as a limitation.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: I will. I'll redo the calculation before writing the conclusion.
